record_type_quote: In this comment, we show that the second set of results rests on two mistakes in the analysis: three-quarters of the observations are duplicates and income inequality is calculated over too few workers to be meaningful.

targets.title: Cooperative property rights and development: Evidence from land reform in El Salvador.
targets.evidence_quote: In columns 1 and 2 of table 1, we reproduce the main results on worker equity using this specification.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: The left figure reproduces figure 6 in Montero (2022).
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: We thus conclude that the original results on property right system on inequality do not hold for any reasonable sample restriction.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original coefficients and figure are reproduced; removing duplicate observations and implementing stated or alternative reasonable sample restrictions undermines income and inequality findings.

reasoning: Reanalysis of Montero’s own data and code, with corrected data construction and sensitivity analyses; no new independent sample.
